A01.summary: Shown: dmchurch Action.getStoryTexts parses numbered XML stories with condition text into structured records. Original Progress Knight uses task descriptions and notifications; no NPC reply graph found in inspected files. Evolve uses event/message flavor. Whole XML corpus, every fork and late event choice remains partial.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Store narrative availability and reading separately from completed work. Owner: docs/worlds/PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md; src/data/dialogues.js; src/life_record.js.

A02.summary: Shown: Idle Loops story flags/vars survive through save initialization; action story text is localized rather than embedded in its save. Evolve has retained message queues and triggered events. Progress Knight presents career/age milestones. No personal companion life graph established.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Retain compact story IDs and facts, with known text reconstructed from its versioned source. Owner: docs/worlds/PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md; src/data/dialogues.js; src/life_record.js.

A03.summary: Shown: original PK is class/registry logic in a monolithic JS update loop; Quest splits main/UI/save modules. Idle Loops separates actions, driver, saving, localization and views; dmchurch adds predictor/editor/worker modules. Evolve is ES modules plus browser UI and worker handling. Seven repositories are separate snapshots, not one merged engine.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Use the incumbent finite work-plan interface rather than importing a fork architecture. Owner: src/feature_expansion_work_plan.js; src/simulation.js.

A04.summary: Shown: PK original saves JSON gameData to localStorage and exports base64; storage writes/import are lightly guarded. Quest omits requirement definitions, saves completed IDs and timestamp, reconstructs definitions/prototypes and catches corrupt load. Its legacy requirement migration has shape-dependent branches, not a proven universal migration. Loops saves learned/story/plan state then rebuilds a run. Evolve uses UTF16 LZ local data/base64 exports and version/shape repairs. All roundtrips unrun.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Save stable completion IDs and rejoin current definitions without copying authored content. Owner: src/save_files.js; src/save_compatibility.js.

A05.summary: Shown: chosen/concurrent task controllers, action plans and population job counters. These are not individual daily lives or utility-planning NPCs. Evolve late faction/government policies and all social actions remain unread.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Keep worker quantities distinct from the state of named people. Owner: src/npc_lives.js; world CAMPAIGN.md.

A06.summary: Shown: task progress tables; editable current/next plans; hotkey/predictor surfaces; dense civilization tabs. Prediction is a display/controller surface and is not authoritative earned output. Layout/accessibility unrun.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: At 1440x900, display current execution beside the next editable plan and mark projections. Owner: docs/THEMATIC_UI_AND_INFORMATION_DESIGN_2026-10-12.md.

A07.summary: Shown: code-defined actions and localized story XML; dmchurch has an editor/schema surface. Evolve tech/action registries mix costs/predicates/effects; PK uses Task/Item definitions and reconstructed requirements. No universal cross-fork mod API or load order established.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Validate action IDs, localized text keys and prerequisites before content enters a campaign. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.

A08.summary: Shown: PK max-level carry changes training; Loops distinguishes temporary raw stats from talents/skills; Evolve traits modify an economy. All endgame curves, RNG and challenge combinations are not read.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Expose which retained skill changes a work rate without collapsing all advancement into one tier. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.

A09.summary: Shown: original PK only advances its running timer; Quest replays elapsed ticks with a cap and age/death boundaries as prior dossier describes. Original Loops banks elapsed time at an offlineRatio of .8; other forks and Evolve have separate acceleration policies. No common offline-aging policy follows.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Declare action time, lifespan time and banked acceleration separately. Owner: src/feature_expansion_work_plan.js; src/simulation.js.

A10.summary: Shown: task requirements, action visible/unlocked predicates and tech prereqs stage complexity. Named information may become visible before execution is affordable. Every fork reveal predicate remains partial.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Separate seen, learned, equipped and affordable states in a local work row. Owner: src/native_discovery_policy.js; src/observation_channels.js.

A11.summary: Shown: keyboard plan controls, predicted results, task bars, save export and message queues. Actual focus behavior, cancellation and predictor accuracy are unrun.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Make planned versus actual results explicit and retain a keyboard route to routine controls. Owner: docs/THEMATIC_UI_AND_INFORMATION_DESIGN_2026-10-12.md.

A12.summary: Shown inventory: careers/rebirth, housing/items, loop challenges, dungeons/town reputation, Evolve species/traits/space/interstellar/portal/eden economies and reset routes. Their extra layers remain references, not selected YAIR milestone gates. Most full catalogues unread.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Keep optional mature paths reachable while selecting only one playable local slice. Owner: docs/TECHNOLOGY_AND_PROGRESSION.md.
